hook: Here's five realistic details in GTA 6 that make Leonida feel way too real.

items.label: Weight Gain
items.body: Jason and Lucia can actually gain or lose weight. Say you spend a week eating junk food instead of exercising. Your character slowly gets bigger, and everyone sees it. Then you hit the gym and it comes back off. Your habits finally show up on your body.
items.evidence: players can gain or lose weight—a returning feature from Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas—as both characters

items.label: Tired Faces
items.body: Skip sleep and the game notices. Say you stay awake as Lucia for days on end, running jobs nonstop. Look in the mirror and the exhaustion is right there, visible on her face. No meter, no pop-up, just her face. Rest finally matters in GTA.
items.evidence: if the player stays awake as either character for days on end, it will become visible on their faces

items.label: Limited Loadout
items.body: No more carrying a whole armory in your pockets. You get two primary firearms and two sidearms at once, and the rest stays in your vehicle. So before a job, you walk to the trunk and pick your tools. Every fight now starts with a real choice.
items.evidence: restricts the player to carrying two primary firearms and two sidearms at once

items.label: Criminal Profile
items.body: The game tracks your reputation with a Criminal Profile. Say you rob a store clean and walk out. That reads as professional. Go wild and hurt people for no reason, and it records unnecessary violence instead. Your choices follow you, and the consequences come later.
items.evidence: track whether each character keeps their crimes professional or commits unnecessary violence with in-game consequences

items.label: NPCs Notice You
items.body: The people of Vice City react to what you do. Lean in to eavesdrop on a stranger's conversation and they notice you. Walk into a store as Lucia in a mask, draw a gun, and shoppers nervously move away. The whole city feels alive around you.
items.evidence: NPCs react more to player actions such as noticing the player eavesdropping on a conversation or nervously moving away upon seeing a masked Lucia drawing a gun

title: 5 Realistic Details in GTA 6 That Feel Too Real 😳 #shorts
description: Five real gameplay details in GTA 6, from weight gain to NPCs who notice everything. Which one surprised you most?
